reviews.text: Best one out there. I’m a small contractor, I’ve been using this app for 4 years. It’s to date still the best one even tho it’s a free one.. it’s simple and really does anything you’d need it to for a simple proposal. The only thing I don’t like is once you save the estimate, if you go back in to alter the estimate it won’t save the new changes. My work around to this has been to screen cap the changes, convert that jpg to pdf and then send.. other than that we should all be giving the app developer (Eric?) a blowie for putting this out there for free..
